detailed_description:
Angular stylised 3D animation, brush-stroke texture, Horsell, Surrey, 1894, low sun from the left, black shadows.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:05. The shot opens on a medium close shot of the neighbour, a tall spare stooping man of forty-eight in a cream straw panama and a sky-blue-and-white striped flannel blazer over white flannel trousers, his hollow cheeks and short pointed grey goatee, an ash walking stick in one fist turned three-quarters toward the camera with the level light on his hollow cheek, his mouth open, both fists on the head of his stick, the heather black behind him. The camera is on the heather level with his eyes, two paces from him, a 50mm lens. He has turned back toward the sun in the west. At the first frame the neighbour's head and shoulders fill the CENTRE of the frame from his cream straw panama at the TOP third to the striped flannel at the BOTTOM edge. The shot is inside this place: Horsell Common with the sun going down in 1894: knee-deep purple-brown heather and dark furze running back from the camera, two young Scots pines standing clear of it. The camera keeps a static shot on the neighbour, keeping his face in the centre of frame as he hauls a breath in, throws his chin up at the sand heaps with his goatee working, and speaks at the camera, from 00:00 to 00:04. <Subject 1> (S1), on screen, a person, with a clipped English voice at an even pace, says: <d>[English] What ugly brutes. Good God, what ugly brutes.</d> His mouth shapes every syllable as the line is heard and closes on the last word. At 00:04, as the line ends, one fist lifts a hand's breadth off the head of the stick, and the lift continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:05 the camera is keeping through the last frame, and the action continues with it.

overall_soundscape: The ambience of Horsell Common with the sun going down in 1894: knee-deep purple-brown heather and dark furze running back from the camera runs under the whole take: its own air, the surfaces underfoot and the fabric of the place around it. Cloth, boots and the small sounds of hands on wood, glass and iron carry the physical action throughout.
